items.name: Market-Stall Bracer
items.lore: Ardee's stall-holders wear these to keep their sleeves out of the butter.

items.name: Constable's Whistle-Charm
items.lore: Daire's spare whistle. One blast and every dog in Ardee barks.

items.name: Rowdy's Sling-Bracer
items.lore: Every rowdy in Connacht carries a sling. Colm's was the worst-made. He's proud of it.

items.name: Hearthstone Ring
items.lore: A pebble from Aine's hearth, set in tin.

items.name: Brothers' Cord
items.lore: Two cords plaited together. Brothers in Connacht trade them.

items.name: Aine's Shawl
items.lore: A blue shawl, darned many times by a mother who sat up waiting.

items.name: Bead-Man's Satchel Belt
items.lore: It carried a fortune in blue glass. It carries your things now, which are worth more.

items.name: Lookout's Torc
items.lore: Twisted bronze off the gang's north lookout. Somebody's grandmother's, probably.

items.name: Blue-Glass Ward
items.lore: One of the Azure Order's beads, cracked on purpose. The Rowan say a broken bead can't buy anyone.

items.name: Road-Boss's Knuckle Ring
items.lore: Heavy, cruel and very well made. Like its owner, minus the well made.

items.name: Tir na Nog Road Cloak
items.lore: The road-wardens' grey. Constable Daire had it made for you.

items.name: Hedgerow Sash
items.lore: Woven from hedge-thorn and tough as wire. The gang hid in the hedgerows. Now you know how.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook Charm
items.lore: Carved from the head of a scorched crook. It still smells of sheep.

items.name: Moor-Wind Bracer
items.lore: Leather cured on the Moors. The wind gets into it and never quite leaves.

items.name: Grave-Ring Pendant
items.lore: A chip of the ring-stone, holed and strung. The old dead slept better with it in place.

items.name: Barrow-Wight's Girdle
items.lore: Bronze links from a broken grave. You put the bones back. You kept the belt.

items.name: Pawn's Grip Ring
items.lore: Off a skeleton's finger. It was holding on very tightly.

items.name: Windaille's Howl-Bracer
items.lore: It whistles faintly when you run.

items.name: Fire-Carrier's Lantern-Charm
items.lore: The blue shade off the fire-carrier's lantern, cracked and set. It glows when the Azure Order is near.

items.name: Four Winds Cloak
items.lore: Grey, blue, white and black: a quarter for each wind. The Moor's shepherds bless it.

items.name: Fianna Signal-Horn Charm
items.lore: A Fianna horn-tip. One note and Druim Ligen hears it.

items.name: Rowan-Berry Bracelet
items.lore: Druidess Eabha sent it from Ardee. 'For the one who put the fire out.'

items.name: Withy-Cord Belt
items.lore: Blue cord off a bundle of stolen withies. The Order of the Rowan took the colour out of it.

items.name: Sapling-Heart Bracer
items.lore: Living bark, gently taken. It grows a little in spring.

items.name: Cellar-Key Ring
items.lore: Mac an Ol's cellar key, bent into a ring. He says he'll never need it again. He'll need it again.

items.name: Lodge-Brewer's Apron Cloak
items.lore: It has stains older than you. Some of them are ale.

items.name: Cluricaun Thimble Charm
items.lore: A thimble of whiskey, frozen in amber. A cluricaun's idea of a keepsake.

items.name: Woodcutter's Axe-Haft Bracer
items.lore: Cut from Broc's own axe-haft. The wood is sorry about the rest of it.

items.name: Order-Tally Charm
items.lore: A notched tally stick from Broc's cart. Forty notches, one cut through.

items.name: Heartwood Torc
items.lore: A ring of living heartwood. Ruadhnait grew it round your neck while you slept, which you'll admit is a little alarming.

items.name: Blight-Breaker Ring
items.lore: A ring of blight-burnt bark, hardened to iron. What hurt the Elder made this strong.

items.name: Seedling Mantle
items.lore: Green as new leaves. It smells of rain after a hot day.

items.name: Rowan-Grove Sash
items.lore: The Order of the Rowan's sash, red with berries. They don't give it lightly.

items.name: Recruiter's List-Case Belt
items.lore: A leather tube for rolled lists. The list in it is ash now.

items.name: Azure-Stitch Bracer
items.lore: Unpicked from an acolyte's robe. Blue thread holds a ward better than most.

items.name: Withe-Bark Ring
items.lore: From the oldest wickerman. It's still warm. It's always going to be warm.

items.name: Phantom-Ash Charm
items.lore: Ash from a wicker that walked. The Rowan say it remembers who burned in it.

items.name: Wicker-Ash Charm
items.lore: Ash from a wicker man that never burned its captive.

items.name: Azure Robe-Clasp
items.lore: The clasp of an Azure Order robe. Ronan kept his.

items.name: Champion's Ring
items.lore: Fiachra's own. The Champions of Connacht give them for valour.

items.name: Patrol-Spear Bracer
items.lore: The haft of a patrol's spear, cut down and bound.

items.name: Fire-Chant Scroll Case
items.lore: It held the Order's fire-chant. Ruadhnait burned the scroll and gave you the case. 'The case did nothing wrong.'

items.name: Idolater's Ember Ring
items.lore: A blue ember sealed in glass. The Rowan put it out; the glass kept the colour.

items.name: Rowan-Thorn Bracer
items.lore: Rowan wood and blackthorn, bound with red thread. Fire won't take it.

items.name: Great-Wicker Ash Mantle
items.lore: Grey with ash from the great burning that never was. The Rowan wove a rowan-berry border into it.

items.name: Hand of the Voice Signet
items.lore: Sciathan's ring: a blue flame on silver. The Rowan cracked the flame.

items.name: Captive's Rope Belt
items.lore: The rope that bound the Ardee farmers, cut and plaited by the farmers themselves.

items.name: Druidess's Rowan Torc
items.lore: Eabha's own torc of rowan and bronze. She says she has another. She doesn't.

items.name: Laughing Cap Charm
items.lore: A farmhand's cap with a blue bead sewn in the band. It giggles when you're not looking.

items.name: Sleepwalker's Bracer
items.lore: The Touched move like dancers. Something of that stays in the leather.

items.name: Famine's Gnawed Torc
items.lore: Famine chewed on it for a century. It tastes of nothing now.

items.name: Alp-Skin Belt
items.lore: The alp luachra eat from inside. Their skins keep things out. Funny, that.

items.name: Feast-Table Ring
items.lore: A napkin ring from the Fool's Court, carved with laughing mouths.

items.name: Dorbal's Horn Charm
items.lore: Dorbal's horn - what the pookha didn't take.

items.name: Pookha-Hair Bracer
items.lore: Grey hair, plaited. The pookha gave it, so it's probably cursed. Probably only a little.

items.name: Broken-Bargain Ring
items.lore: A pookha's promise, broken. It's iron now. Pookhas hate iron.

items.name: Fool-King's Bargain-Knot
items.lore: Blue cord and black, knotted together. The bargain, undone. It hums when you're lied to.

items.name: Black Jester's Motley Cloak
items.lore: Black and blue diamonds, the colours of the bargain. The bells have been taken off.

items.name: Court-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Iron, plain and heavy. Nothing in the Fool's Court can bear to touch it.

items.name: Rowan-Crowned Torc
items.lore: A torc woven with fresh rowan, never wilting. The Order's highest thanks.

items.name: Raid-Ledger Satchel Belt
items.lore: The siabra captain kept her accounts in this. The Fianna keep it now, empty, as a reminder.

items.name: Siabra Tent-Peg Bracer
items.lore: Bone pegs, lashed together. The raiders' tents won't stand again.

items.name: Gate-Glass Pendant
items.lore: Fused blue glass from the gate's stones. It's cold. Fire-glass shouldn't be cold.

items.name: Watch-Post Cloak
items.lore: The Fianna's gate-watch cloak, grey and heavy. It's seen a lot of bad nights.

items.name: Manes-Fang Ring
items.lore: A manes demon's tooth, in an iron band. It still tries to bite.

items.name: Jester's Bell Charm
items.lore: One bell from Lorcan's cap. It doesn't ring any more. You made sure.

items.name: Turncoat's Belt
items.lore: Reversible: Fianna green on one side, fool's motley on the other.

items.name: Keep-Watch Bracer
items.lore: Druim Ligen's gate-watch bracer. Fiachra's sentinels saluted when you put it on.

items.name: Gate-Lord's Iron Torc
items.lore: Wrought from the gate-lord's chain. It's cold and heavy and it doesn't care.

items.name: Druim Ligen Champion's Mantle
items.lore: Green, with a silver fian-ring. Fiachra said you'd earned the green. Then he said it again, louder.

items.name: Ember-Quench Ring
items.lore: Blue fire, sealed in iron and drowned. Druidess Eabha sent it from Ardee.

items.name: Fian-Oath Bracer
items.lore: Bound with the old fian oath: never refuse a fight, never refuse a guest. One of those is easier.

items.name: Thumb of Knowledge
items.lore: Burned, a little, on one side. Put your thumb to it when you don't know what to do. It doesn't always help.

items.name: Poet's Hazel Charm
items.lore: Nine hazelnuts of wisdom fell into the well where the salmon was born. This is one of the shells.
